## About Setzet
Setzet is a premium strategy-led web design and development agency. We engineer blazing-fast websites, scalable custom software, and digital experiences that turn traffic into fiercely loyal customers. 

## Services Offered
1. UI/UX Design: Intuitive and visually stunning interfaces, wireframes, and prototypes.
2. Web Development: High-performance, SEO-ready Next.js web applications.
3. Mobile App Development: Scalable cross-platform and native mobile apps.
4. Custom Software Development: Reliable backend, API integrations, and tailored software solutions.
5. SEO & Growth: Strategy-led SEO implementation to drive organic growth.
6. Influencer Marketing: Connecting brands with top-tier influencers for maximum ROI.
7. API Development: Designing, building, and integrating robust, secure APIs.
8. Conversion Optimization: Data-driven CRO strategies to turn visitors into customers.
9. E-Commerce Development: Building high-converting, scalable online store platforms.
10. Marketing Automation: Implementing AI-driven workflows to save time and boost conversions.
11. Performance Marketing: Data-driven paid ad campaigns for maximum ROAS.
12. Social Media Marketing: Building brand presence, awareness, and community engagement.
